claims.title: Acquired affine-row-prefix counting and uniform original-input sampling

quoted_fields.interface: A binary-affine acquired matrix-product slice admits exact row-prefix completion counts,witnesses and uniform original-input samples in2^c times polynomial expected time without an exponential growing-prefix factor. The native family explicitly bounds2^c by compact description bytes. Correct field actions and original affine translation are required.
quoted_fields.failure: Unrestricted c remains exponential. Acquired row prefixes are not arbitrary original-bit conditioning. Full-fiber rejection can be exponentially bad at c=1. Exact sampling assumes unbiased integer draws. The older rank-one sampler remains complementary. Source benchmarks are scoped records,not intake replay or a general advantage.

claims.title: Acquired all-output affine sections without small codimension

quoted_fields.interface: An acquired regular common-field matrix dual with zero common kernel,equal source/target dimension and every natural multiplicity at least two admits a constructed invertible primal affine representative and one affine original-input section for every consistent marked output. This search result requires neither small c nor a target-carrier arrangement.
quoted_fields.failure: Multiplicity one can obstruct this invertible-transversal construction. It is not search hardness. A witness section is not full-fiber counting or uniform sampling. Equal field degrees do not imply common scalar operators. Historical code review predates one bytecode-guard line; the exact relationship and final owner read remain visible.

claims.title: Two-factor exact counting with distinct target carriers and affine phases

quoted_fields.interface: Exactly two acquired regular common-field matrix factors with zero common kernel,positive multiplicities and zero/one-joint-copy targets admit deterministic polynomial original-input counting for arbitrary affine phases and distinct or overlapping target carriers through an explicit29-type E6 two-flag census.
quoted_fields.failure: No arbitrary three-factor,unrestricted Boolean counting or polynomial full-family sampling theorem. One bit can introduce a nonsemisimple radical and break the inherited self-reduction certificate. The actual E6 native fixture has c=8 and an already feasible256-character fallback; high-c formula growth is not native acquisition.
